# Care arrangements

Mum wants to keep choosing her own appointments and collecting her medication. My jobs are arranging transport when asked, checking that the shared calendar matches the latest letter and being a contact for changes she wants help with. Lena holds the spare key because Mum asked her. We need a backup for holidays without treating Lena as permanently on call.

Keep the current plan on half a page. Old letters belong behind it, marked when superseded. An appointment includes the journey and the return, not only the time with the clinician. Do not replace a choice Mum makes with a more convenient arrangement unless we discuss it. The notebook is an aid to care and should not become a description of everything she does. [[Routes]] includes the accessible journey to the clinic.
